title: 第193章 尼可：这不是天使的力量
slug: 在须弥假装是一个学者
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“喂，总算找到你了，王言，我们带着尼可回来啦。”

脚步声和派蒙的声音同时响起。

王言从思考中回过神来，转头看向后方，派蒙和荧不知道什么时候出现在了这里。

“你们怎么这么快就回来了？”

从分开到现在，也不过大半天的时间吧？

你们就跨越大半个地图，弄了一个来回？

金龙浑身上下的鳞片在阳光下闪闪发亮，将一道道光芒反射向大地。

一道鲜血从青发巨牙狼的前掌上喷涌出来，隔着屏幕看到这一幕的归龙，眼神中也出现了几分惊疑。

这种返回舱降落的位置只能估计而不能控制，所以也就做不到像空天飞机那样降落在机场上的操作。

他挥动手中让帝国猩猩们胆寒的特殊旗帜时，位于他身后五百米的联邦机甲兵团，像是得到了的号令一样。

第(1/3)页
content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Hey, I finally found you, Wang Yan, we are back with Nico."

Footsteps and Paimon's voice sounded at the same time.

Wang Yan came back from his thoughts and turned to look behind him. Paimon and Ying appeared here without knowing when.

"Why are you back so soon?"

It's only been half a day since we separated, right?

You just crossed half of the map and made a round trip?

The scales all over the golden dragon's body shone brightly in the sunlight, reflecting beams of light towards the earth.

A stream of blood spurted out from the front palm of the blue-haired giant-tusked wolf. Gui Long, who saw this scene through the screen, had a bit of surprise in his eyes.

The landing position of this kind of return capsule can only be estimated but not controlled, so it cannot land at the airport like an aerospace plane.

When he waved the special flag in his hand that made the imperial apes fearful, the federal mecha corps located five hundred meters behind him seemed to have received an order.
